messages.author: 58b200ca833b5c34
messages.subject: featureCounts and counting by Read Group?
parts: Hey, is it possible to have an option for featureCounts which counts each alignment in a bam file by read groups? The reason behind this is the following. We have bam files which have several libraries in it. This can come from single cell sequencing, differentiation of UMIs or just a merge of several bam files. Therefore, this option would help a lot. The input would still be the same. You give the program one or multiple bam files. When you active the option, instead of one column per bam file, you get several columns and each column header could be nameOfInputFile_ReadGroup. If a bam file has no read group or a single read group but the option is actived, I'd suggest to only write the the name of the inputfile in the header.

Hi Wei,

Thanks for the answer and I look forward once it's implemented. I have only one extra comment regarding having a single read group or none in bam file. If there is no read group in the bam file, it would be good to just write the bam file name in the read count table. If there is a single read group in the bam file, I would prefer the naming scheme nameInputFile_ReadGroupID or ReadGroupID_nameInputFile.

Thanks
